name: 22nd Annual Academic Surgical Congress 2027
organizer: Association for Academic Surgery and Society of University Surgeons
description: The Academic Surgical Congress is the joint annual meeting of the Association for Academic Surgery and the Society of University Surgeons for surgeon scientists. The 2027 edition is the 22nd annual meeting and takes place in Washington, D.C.

notes: The official academicsurgicalcongress.org and aasurg.org domains returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to direct fetch, so most details rely on search-engine snippets of those pages plus the academicsurgicalcongress.us mirror. There is an unresolved discrepancy between the abstract submission close date reported by the organizer's social media (August 7, 2026) and the academicsurgicalcongress.us portal (August 17, 2026); August 7 was used as the primary value because it was corroborated by multiple independent search snippets of the official site and repeated organizer social posts.
